title: dactylorhiza fuchsii subsp. psychrophila
intro: Dactylorhiza fuchsii subsp. psychrophila, commonly known as the Northern Marsh-Orchid, is a subspecies of orchid that belongs to the Dactylorhiza fuchsii species. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and promote the removal of mucus from the airways. The bioactive constituents of Dactylorhiza fuchsii subsp. psychrophila include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
